Package dev.relism.flash.ext.security

Class SecurityModule

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.security.SecurityModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
public class SecurityModule extends Object implements Module
Flash security for an app: the Security service, the policies security annotations declare, sessions, and the /auth/logout and /auth/methods routes. A way to authenticate is an AuthenticationMechanism added to the app, by an app or by a module such as OidcModule; they are tried in the order they were added, then the session. 

 app.install(new SecurityModule().users(users).roles(roles).origin("https://app.example"),
             new OidcModule(OidcProvider.of("sso", issuer, clientId, secret)));

    • loginPage

      public SecurityModule loginPage(String loginPage)
      Where a browser signs in. Unset: straight to the only LoginMethod when it is a redirect, /login otherwise. Set it when the application's page knows ways in the list does not, like a provider picked by email.

    • origin

      public SecurityModule origin(String origin)
      Where the application is served, e.g. https://app.example: what session cookies, sign-in callbacks and token audiences are built from. Unset, each request's own origin is used, which the client chooses — set it wherever that matters, which is every deployment.

    • security

      public Security security()
      The service this module installs, for what is written before the app starts: a route's own security.enforce(...) middleware, a lambda that signs a user in. A class takes it as a constructor parameter instead.
